req.title: Reject empty title on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field of POST /tasks/ is missing.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-002 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is missing from POST /tasks/. The schema enforces title as required (min_length=1, max_length=100). Tests cover: (1) positive EP — valid payload with title present returns 201; (2) negative NEG — payload with title completely absent returns 422; (3) boundary BVA — title as empty string '' (length 0, one below min_length=1) returns 422; (4) boundary BVA — title as single char (length 1, exactly at min_length) returns 201; (5) negative DT — null title value returns 422; (6) boundary BVA — title of exactly 100 characters returns 201; (7) negative NEG — title of 101 characters returns 422. The violation in test[6] was kind=negative with heuristic=BVA; BVA tests that probe a boundary point one above max_length and expect rejection are correctly classified as kind=boundary since the test is defined by the boundary value, not a generic negative equivalence class.

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201():
    payload = {"title": "Buy groceries", "description": "A", "completed": True}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert body["completed"] is True
    assert "id" in body

test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201()
